messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT OPENED: gpu-pool-usw2 reporting sustained queue growth and autoscaler errors >= 10m. Severity: P1. Affected: hosted inference (text-gen), increased 429s and token latency. Links: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1938200000 :rotating_light:

maria: seeing queues climb from 200 -> 2.3k over 12m, autoscaler logs show repeated 'scale_failed: MaxPoolSize' and cloud provider preemptions on spot nodes. Customer-facing latency SLOs breached.

josh: confirmed, metric: gpu-queue-length{pool="usw2-spot"} = 2300 at 1938200060. Token throttle rate up ~18%.

lee: logs from autoscaler: ```
I0331 19:24:02.123 autoscaler.go:312] request_scale up to 48 GPUs
E0331 19:24:03.456 autoscaler.go:318] scale_failed: quotaExceeded: cannot create instances, project quota 40 GPUs
W0331 19:25:10.789 autoscaler.go:400] spot_preempt: instance-gtx-12 preempted (3 nodes)
```

amanda: provider shows spot interruptions across three AZs, fallback capacity pool (reserved) at 60% utilization, no spare GPUs. We tried burst-to-dedicated but policy blocked due to pending commit limit.

peter: customers impacted: several high-traffic PLG apps - logs show 429s and shorter responses. CS has a request from acme-inc for incident update.

maria: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) Short-term: route non-critical low-priority requests to smaller model (gpt-small) and enable token-capping; 2) Open emergency dedicated burst to AWS reserved pool (if ops approve); 3) Adjust autoscaler policy to lower batch thresholds to reduce queue pressure. Prefer 1+2 now.

josh: started a quick router rule: `route: if customer_tier != enterprise -> model=gpt-small` — pushing config now. Expect queue drop ~15-25% in 3-5m.

lee: I'm on infra to attempt manual scale via cloud console but quota failure persists. Raising support with cloud provider now.

pagerduty-bot: Paging on-call: @josh is primary SRE (on call). Acknowledged by josh at 1938200125.

josh: taking this. I'll coordinate with infra and product for downgrade fence. Maria, can you draft a short customer note for CS?

maria: on it. Short note: "We are experiencing degraded inference throughput due to spot node interruptions and temporary capacity limits. We have enacted routing to smaller models for non-critical traffic and are attempting emergency capacity increases. We'll update in 30m or on resolution."

amanda: update from cloud support: we have temporary per-project quota locked by a pending request — there's a 24h review delay. They suggest using spare dedicated quota in partner account — need ops approval to switch billing context.

peter: ops, do we have standing agreements for partner bursting? If yes, what's the latency to flip?

amanda: takes ~6-12m with automation script, manual if keys available.

josh: given quota delay, implement model routing + token caps immediately and open partner-burst as fallback. Maria, can CS show the degraded ETA 1h?

maria: yes, ETA 1h and will add link to status page.

lee: changed autoscaler config to reduce desired batch_size from 64 -> 32 and lowered scale_cooldown to 30s. Might reduce per-request latency but increase total GPU ops. Watch for oscillation.

josh: confirmed config push at 1938200300. Monitoring dashboards: queue dropped to 1.6k at 1938200400. Throttles down to 11%.

pagerduty-bot: New alert: fallback-routing-delay exceeded threshold (120s) for route service in us-west-2.

amanda: noticed a misconfigured route priority — some legacy routes still pointing to primary pool. Fixing now.

josh: handover: I'm going to sleep-cycle; @lee please take over active incident lead. I'll stay reachable.

lee: taking over at 1938200600. Action list posted to incident channel and incident doc: - confirm partner burst - monitor queue and throttles - coordinate CS comms - keep autoscaler conservative.

maria: CS updated customers at 1938200645. Customer reported reduced error rates but some increased latency for heavy requests.

peter: final note: after partner-burst enabled at 1938200720 we saw steady drain; queue fell below 300 by 1938200800 and throttles down to 2%. Providers still reporting spot churn but load now satisfied.

lee: incident resolved at 1938200850. Postmortem owner: maria. Follow-ups: request extra reserved capacity in us-west-2, improve autoscaler fallback to prefer reserved/dedicated, add playbook step to flip partner-burst, and add regression test for route priorities.

maria: acknowledged and creating postmortem ticket: TICKET-8482."
